title: THE CATSPAW DAGGER EXPLAINED
narrative: Howland Reed scoffs into his marsh-tea. 'Joffrey? Littlefinger? Robert? The truth was far dumber. Littlefinger lost the dagger in a drunken bet to Renly, who left it on a table in the Red Keep, where a kitchen boy stole it, sold it to a fence, who sold it to Robert's armorer, who shoved it in a baggage train wagon where Joffrey stole it to impress his father because Joffrey was an illiterate psychopath who didn't know Valyrian steel from pig-iron.' The entire court falls silent at how much continental bloodshed resulted from a petulant toddler with bad impulse control.

options.text: Fast-forward time: address the scrapped 5-year gap before fighting the Others.
March South with the Free Folk and liberate Winterfell from Ramsay Bolton.
